title: Deep learning classifies cervical cytology whole-slide images as neoplastic or not
summary: A deep learning model was trained on 1605 whole-slide images of liquid-based cervical cytology to classify slides as neoplastic or non-neoplastic. On three test sets totaling 1468 slides it reached ROC AUCs of 0.89 to 0.96 for slide-level diagnosis. The authors present it as a promising aid for screening workflows. The abstract does not describe the independence of the test sets or any prospective use.
